001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008
009/**
010 * Calling when success purchase in shop
011 */
012public class ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
013
014  @NotNull
015  private final Shop shop;
016
017  private final int amount;
018
019  @NotNull
020  private final QUser purchaser;
021
022  @NotNull
023  private final InventoryWrapper purchaserInventory;
024
025  private final double tax;
026
027  private final double
028          total; // Don't use getter, we have important notice need told dev in javadoc.
029
030  /**
031   * Builds a new shop purchase event Will called when purchase ended
032   *
033   * @param shop               The shop bought from
034   * @param purchaser          The player buying, may offline if purchase by plugin
035   * @param purchaserInventory The purchaseing target inventory, *MAY NOT A PLAYER INVENTORY IF
036   *                           PLUGIN PURCHASE THIS*
037   * @param amount             The amount they're buying
038   * @param tax                The tax in this purchase
039   * @param total              The money in this purchase
040   */
041  public ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent(
042          @NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final QUser purchaser, @NotNull final InventoryWrapper purchaserInventory, final int amount, final double total, final double tax) {
043
044    this.shop = shop;
045    this.purchaser = purchaser;
046    this.purchaserInventory = purchaserInventory;
047    this.amount = amount * shop.getItem().getAmount();
048    this.tax = tax;
049    this.total = total;
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Gets the item stack amounts
054   *
055   * @return Item stack amounts
056   */
057  public int getAmount() {
058
059    return this.amount;
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * The total money changes in this purchase. Calculate tax, if you want get total without tax,
064   * please use getBalanceWithoutTax()
065   *
066   * @return the total money with calculate tax
067   */
068  public double getBalance() {
069
070    return this.total - tax;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * The total money changes in this purchase. No calculate tax, if you want get total with tax,
075   * please use getBalance()
076   *
077   * @return the total money without calculate tax
078   */
079  public double getBalanceWithoutTax() {
080
081    return this.total;
082  }
083
084
085  /**
086   * Gets the purchaser, that maybe is a online/offline/virtual player.
087   *
088   * @return The purchaser uuid
089   */
090  public @NotNull QUser getPurchaser() {
091
092    return this.purchaser;
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Gets the inventory of purchaser (the item will put to)
097   *
098   * @return The inventory
099   */
100  public @NotNull InventoryWrapper getPurchaserInventory() {
101
102    return this.purchaserInventory;
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * Gets the shop
107   *
108   * @return the shop
109   */
110  public @NotNull Shop getShop() {
111
112    return this.shop;
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Gets the tax in this purchase
117   *
118   * @return The tax
119   */
120  public double getTax() {
121
122    return this.tax;
123  }
124}
